headline: French AI infrastructure company Sesterce plans to invest more than 10 billion euros in an AI data center campus at a former paper mill in central Finland.
score_reason: Kept at pool score 7: new announcement on 8 Oct 2026 carried by several outlets; still a plan with permits pending.
importance_line: Central Finland would gain jobs and a large power customer, but this is a plan: permits are still needed, the sale of the site is not final and the renewable-energy pledge is the company's own target.
summary: The Next Web reports, citing Sesterce's announcement, that the campus at Jämsä would start with 200 megawatts in a first phase, with building due to begin this year, and reach 600 megawatts in a second phase, creating about 2,000 construction jobs and 300 permanent ones. Local officials welcomed the plan but noted that permits are still required, and the site's owner says talks to sell it to Sesterce are well advanced.
notes: Data Center Dynamics (pool link) is blocked here; read The Next Web's report, which cites Sesterce and Yle. DCD headline says $10bn, TNW says over 10 billion euros; euros used. Url is where the text was read.
